title: 241. Candy

examples.explanation: You can allocate to the first, second and third child with 2, 1, 2 candies respectively.
You can allocate to the first, second and third child with 1, 2, 1 candies respectively.

hints: Start by giving every child one candy.
A left-to-right pass fixes the left neighbor requirement: if ratings[i] > ratings[i-1], give child i more than child i-1.
A right-to-left pass fixes the right neighbor requirement; take the max of the two passes for each child.
